children: The Bulgarian economy grew 2.8% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, slightly above the preliminary estimate of 2.7% but slowing from a revised 3% in the previous quarter.
It marked the weakest pace of expansion since Q1 2024, as domestic consumption growth slowed to 6.2% from 7.6% in Q1.
Household consumption eased to 7.6% from 8.6%, while government spending fell 2.7% after rising 2.2% in Q1.
Gross fixed capital formation also moderated to 8.4% from 8.7%.
Net external demand made a positive contribution to GDP growth, as exports of goods and services rebounded to 0.2% after falling 7.1% in Q1, while imports edged up to 8.5% from 8.2% previously.
On a seasonally quarterly basis, the economy expanded 0.7% in Q2, slightly above the preliminary estimate of 0.6% and unchanged from the previous quarter.

title: Bulgaria Q2 GDP Revised Slightly Higher
